Project Management

Become a World-Class Project Manager

Master the skills to plan, lead cross-functional teams, and execute projects on time and within budget.

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

The Project Management course is designed to empower aspiring delivery professionals with the practical skills to plan, execute, monitor, and control projects of any size and complexity.
You’ll learn the full project lifecycle, from initiation and planning, through execution and monitoring, to closing and tailoring, including traditional (predictive) approaches and adaptive/hybrid methods.
This beginner-friendly course blends foundational theory with real-world tools and techniques, helping you transition into a career as a Project Manager, Project Coordinator, or a specialist in programme/portfolio roles.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand the core principles of project management and the end-to-end project lifecycle: initiating, planning, executing, monitoring & controlling, and closing.
  2. Apply project management systems and governance frameworks across project, programme, and portfolio levels.
  3. Perform key work-domain activities: scope management, schedule management, cost & resource management, stakeholder & team management, risk & quality management, communication & procurement.
  4. Tailor project management approaches (predictive, adaptive, hybrid) and integrate emerging practices, including AI for projects and the intersection of product & project management.
  5. Develop career-ready skills: build your CV, prepare for interviews, and present a capstone project that demonstrates your project management competencies across industries.

  5. Nigeria -₦6 million – ₦10 million NGN

  7. Remote/Global Roles – $75,000 – $125,000 USD

  1. Project Manager
  2. Project Coordinator
  3. Technical Project Manager
  4. Program/Portfolio Manager

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Project Manager in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to Project Management
  • Foundational elements of projects
  • Project/Program/Portfolio and Operations management
  • Project Governance
Module 2 - Project Management Principles & Systems for Delivery
  • The project environment & The Project Management Office (PMO)
Module 3 - The Project Lifecycle & Development Approach
  • PM Lifecycle focus areas – Initiating, planning, executing, monitoring & controlling
  • Predictive / Adaptive / Hybrid approaches
Module 4 -Project Management Domain - Scope Management
  • Scope planning & Collecting requirements
  • Scope definition
  • Creating a work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Validation & control of scope
Module 5 - Project Management Domain - Schedule Management
  • Schedule planning & activities definition
  • Activity sequencing and duration estimation
  • Schedule development & control
Module 6 - Project Management Domain - Finance/Cost & Resource Management
  • Cost planning & cost estimation
  • Cost control & budget management
  • Resource estimation, acquisition, and management
Module 7 - Project Management Domain - Stakeholder & Team Management
  • Stakeholder identification, engagement, and management across the project lifecycle
  • Creating a Collaborative Project Team Environment
Module 8 - Project Management Domain - Risk & Quality Management
  • Risk identification on projects
  • Risk analysis & responses
  • Risk monitoring
  • Quality planning, management & control
Module 9 - Other domains - Communication & Procurement Management
  • Communication Management
  • Procurement Management – Planning, Conduct & Control
Module 10 - Tailoring Projects
  • Tailoring projects, processes & the PM domains
  • Models, methods & project artifacts
  • AI for projects
  • The Intersection of product and project management
Module 11 - Wrap-Up, Career Preparation & Capstone Project
  • CV & Interview preparation
  • Demonstrating & applying your PM skills across different industries
